text: I ratify the ACT_NOW camp's h1_close_above:bar_high: W HH/HL, D 0.94% under the 20-day high, H1 above EMA9, an Upward Trend at its high (C5). A Creek pull-in first is waiting to buy the reaction, which C5 forbids; waiting for a lower entry usually misses the move. Minervini's volume test is his clause, not mine (R5). Wrong if a one-day fall of 1x atr_14d from the day's high (C7, my translation). What would move me: a rally stalling short of the high, then a 0.5x atr_14d reaction from it (C20, my translation).
